name: @zkuat/anchor
description: zkuat anchor — the trust boundary. Verifies an evidence bundle against a trusted attestor key set, verifies the Sigstore attestation and its repo binding, enforces one anchor per (repo, commit), and submits attest(leaf) to Midnight.
comment:midnight-sdk: There is deliberately no @midnight-ntwrk/* dependency here. The SDK loads a WASM module, and two copies of it in one process means two class registries: an object minted by one fails every instanceof check in the other, which surfaces as `expected instance of StateValue` on the first circuit call. contract/src/devnet/sdk.ts re-exports the handful of symbols this package needs, so they resolve inside contract/node_modules and there is exactly one instance. Do not add @midnight-ntwrk packages here.
